Sub SearchForPasswords()
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folder As Object
    Dim file As Object
    Dim password As String
    Dim filePath As String
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim fileExtension As String
    Dim passwordFile As String

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder("C:\Users\Public\Documents\Passwords")
    passwordFile = "C:\Users\Public\Documents\Passwords\passwords.txt"

    For Each file In folder.Files
        fileName = file.Name
        fileExtension = fso.GetExtensionName(fileName)
        If fileExtension = "txt" Or fileExtension = "doc" Or fileExtension = "docx" Or fileExtension = "xls" Or fileExtension = "xlsx" Or fileExtension = "ppt" Or fileExtension = "pptx" Then
            filePath = file.Path
            Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
            Set objExecObject = objShell.Exec("cmd /c findstr /s /p " & Chr(34) & filePath & Chr(34) & " " & Chr(34) & passwordFile & Chr(34))
            password = objExecObject.StdOut.ReadAll
            If password <> "" Then
                MsgBox "Password found in " & fileName & ": " & password
            End If
        End If
    Next

    Set fso = Nothing
    Set folder = Nothing

Sub ExtractPasswords()
    Dim doc As Document
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim strPassword As String

def generate_medical_hash_table(hashed_codes):
    """Generate a table of potential matches for a collection of medical hash codes."""
    # Create a dictionary to store the potential matches
    potential_matches = {}
    
    # Iterate through the hashed codes and generate potential matches
    for code in hashed_codes:
        # Check if the code is already in the dictionary
        if code in potential_matches:
            # If it is, add the new match to the existing list
            potential_matches[code].append(code)
        else:
            # If it's not, create a new list with the code as the only element
            potential_matches[code] = [code]
    
    # Return the dictionary of potential matches
    return potential_matches
